mapper.sql: m.device_code, m.device_status, m.province_code, m.city_code, m.county_code, m.town_code, m.location, m.longitude, m.latitude, m.area_code, m.adm_code, m.manufacturer_code, m.model_code, m.site_code, m.is_cascade, m.collect_type, m.creator, m.create_time, m.modifier, m.update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT d.dict_value AS categoryCode, d.dict_label AS deviceTypeName, IFNULL(COUNT(m.device_type), 0) AS deviceTypeNum FROM sys_dict_data d LEFT JOIN vm_uav_device_info_t m ON d.dict_value = m.device_type AND m.delete_flag = '0' AND m.device_type IS NOT NULL AND m.device_type != '' WHERE d.dict_type = 'uav_device_type'
AND m.device_code in
#{deviceCode}
GROUP BY d.dict_value ORDER BY deviceTypeNum desc

SELECT d.dict_value AS categoryCode, d.dict_label AS deviceTypeName, IFNULL(COUNT(m.device_type), 0) AS deviceTypeNum FROM sys_dict_data d LEFT JOIN vm_horn_device_info_t m ON d.dict_value = m.device_type AND m.delete_flag = '0' AND m.device_type IS NOT NULL AND m.device_type != '' WHERE d.dict_type = 'broadcast_device_type'
AND m.device_code in
#{deviceCode}
GROUP BY d.dict_value ORDER BY deviceTypeNum desc

SELECT d.dict_value AS categoryCode, d.dict_label AS deviceTypeName, IFNULL(COUNT(m.device_type), 0) AS deviceTypeNum FROM sys_dict_data d LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_t m ON d.dict_value = m.device_type AND m.delete_flag = '0' AND m.category_code = 2 AND m.device_type IS NOT NULL AND m.device_type != '' WHERE d.dict_type = 'iot_device_model_type'
AND m.device_code in
#{deviceCode}
GROUP BY d.dict_value ORDER BY deviceTypeNum desc

SELECT d.dict_value AS categoryCode, d.dict_label AS deviceTypeName, IFNULL(COUNT(m.device_type), 0) AS deviceTypeNum FROM sys_dict_data d LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_t m ON d.dict_value = m.device_type AND m.delete_flag = '0' AND m.category_code = 1 AND m.device_type IS NOT NULL AND m.device_type != '' WHERE d.dict_type = 'radar_device_type'
AND m.device_code in
#{deviceCode}
GROUP BY d.dict_value ORDER BY deviceTypeNum desc

select * from ( select distinct ,
CAST(ST_DISTANCE(POINT(#{userLongitude},#{userLatitude}),POINT(m.longitude,m.latitude))*111195 as DECIMAL(65,2)) as distance,
pro.area_name as provinceName, city.area_name as cityName, county.area_name as countyName, town.area_name as townName, case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor, (case when length(IFNULL(rel.device_name, '')) = 0 then m.device_name else rel.device_name end ) device_name, (CASE WHEN od.ord_status in ('0','1','2') THEN '0' WHEN od.ord_status = '3' THEN '2' WHEN od.ord_status = '4' THEN '1' END) orderStatus, (CASE WHEN od.ord_status in ('0','1','2') THEN '有效' WHEN od.ord_status = '3' THEN '退订' WHEN od.ord_status = '4' THEN '失效' END) orderStatusName from vm_recorder_device_info_t m join vm_order_recorder_devices od on od.device_code = m.device_code left join vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = m.device_code and rel.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = od.industry_code and rel.delete_flag = '0' and rel.device_type = '3' left JOIN vm_user_device_collection_t dct ON dct.coll_obj_code = m.device_code and dct.coll_obj_type = '12' AND dct.user_id = #{userId} left join sys_area pro ON pro.area_code = m.province_code left join sys_area city ON city.area_code = m.city_code left join sys_area county ON county.area_code = m.county_code left join sys_area town ON town.area_code = m.town_code
LEFT JOIN vm_organ_device_rel_t vod on vod.device_code = m.device_code and vod.delete_flag = '0' and vod.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and vod.device_type = '13'
and dct.user_device_coll_id IS NOT NULL
and m.device_code in
#{item}
${dataScope}
ORDER BY field(od.ord_status,1,0,2,4,3) ASC ) recorder
1 = 1
and recorder.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{deviceName}, '%')
and recorder.device_code like CONCAT('%', #{codeOrName}, '%') or recorder.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{codeOrName}, '%')
order by recorder.distance,recorder.device_status,cast(recorder.device_code as UNSIGNED),recorder.device_code
order by recorder.device_status,cast(recorder.device_code as UNSIGNED),recorder.device_code
order by recorder.province_code, recorder.city_code, recorder.county_code,recorder.device_code
